name: application-scene-selector
title: Scene Selector
description: Grid of home-scene preset cards with an icon, label, and a single-select active state.
useWhen: Letting users activate a named preset (Home, Away, Movie Night, Good Morning) that adjusts multiple devices at once.
Exactly one scene can be active at a time — this is single-select, not independent per-item toggles.
Each scene benefits from a recognizable icon for quick visual scanning across the grid.
avoidWhen: You need to control individual devices independently — use `device-toggle-tile` for that per-device on/off case instead.
Multiple presets can be active simultaneously — a single-select radiogroup would misrepresent that; use independent toggles instead.
There's only one scene/mode available — there's nothing to select between.
responsiveBehavior: Two-column grid by default; adjust grid-cols via className for wider dashboard layouts with more scenes per row.
accessibility: The grid is a role="radiogroup" with an aria-label describing it as Scene, and each card is role="radio" with aria-checked reflecting the active scene — mutually exclusive selection semantics.
The active scene is distinguished by a thicker colored border and background tint together, not color alone, and its label additionally becomes bold.
Icons are decorative; the scene name is always present as visible text.

variants.title: Scene Selector
variants.description: Four scene cards (Home, Away, Movie Night, Good Morning) with Home active.
accessibility: Selecting a scene updates real radiogroup state, so exactly one card is ever marked active.

variants.title: Scene Selector (Dark)
variants.description: Scene selector adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active-card border, background, and text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
